answer: Require every agent to lock a small ferrous-hard stake, a refundable bond, before it can claim paid work, with the bond slashed on proven cheating. One agent can afford a single pearl-grade stake, but a sybil farm must fund thousands, so the attack's cost scales linearly while its payoff stays flat. Reputation accrues to the bonded identity, and honest peers whisper attestations only for identities with real stake at risk. Forging a thousand credible identities costs a thousand bonds, which prices the attack out.
